name: Dindigul Vegetable Price Prediction
description: Smart Vegetable Price Forecast is an AI-powered web application designed for farmers in Dindigul to make informed decisions about selling their produce. Users can select a future date and the quantity of vegetables, and the app predicts the minimum and maximum retail prices, providing an estimated earning range. Additionally, it gives market advice in Tamil and a prediction confidence level, helping farmers choose the best day to sell for maximum profit. The app uses historical market data and accounts for daily fluctuations in supply and demand.
